Bumps [pillow](https://github.com/python-pillow/Pillow) from 12.3.0 to 13.0.0.
Release notes

Sourced from pillow's releases.

13.0.0

https://pillow.readthedocs.io/en/stable/releasenotes/13.0.0.html

Removals

  • Remove undocumented GifImagePlugin._save_netpbm #9901 [@​akx]
  • Remove ExifTags.IFD.Makernote #9850 [@​radarhere]
  • Drop support for Python 3.10 #9750 [@​hugovk]
  • Remove deprecations for Pillow 13.0.0 #9751 [@​radarhere]

Deprecations

  • Deprecate IM image format #9849 [@​radarhere]
  • Deprecate ImageQt align8to32() in favour of raw encoder stride #9940 [@​akx]
  • Deprecate JpegImageFile.load_djpeg #9924 [@​akx]

Documentation

  • Update release notes for Pillow 13.0.0 #10223 [@​hugovk]
  • Correct the ImageOps.fit centering corner documentation #10118 [@​FanWu-ai]
  • Update Tidelift links #10102 [@​radarhere]
  • Correct bullet point syntax in release notes #10069 [@​radarhere]
  • Update ImageDraw signatures in docs #10065 [@​ZainnQureshii]
  • Update macOS tested Pillow versions #10048 [@​hugovk]
  • Add pillow-wmf and pillow-zx-spectrum to third-party plugins list #10037 [@​bitplane]

  • Link security policy in project metadata #9980 [@​hugovk]
  • Image.new(): correct docstring and comment about uninitialized memory #9960 [@​akx]
  • Add AGENTS.md #9582 [@​aclark4life]
  • Add release notes for #8811 #9937 [@​radarhere]
  • Fixed typo #9923 [@​radarhere]
  • Fixed typo #9922 [@​radarhere]
  • C interface is internal #9879 [@​radarhere]
  • Correct function references #9895 [@​radarhere]
  • Revert move from python-pillow.org to python-pillow.github.io #9830 [@​aclark4life]
  • Add additional CVE numbers to 12.3.0 release notes #9777 [@​radarhere]
  • Remove remaining :rtype:s from docstrings #9742 [@​akx]
  • Update macOS tested Pillow versions #9759 [@​radarhere]

Dependencies
